article.title: Registry of application granted, and order for re-hearings.
article.content: When an application for review is granted, a note thereof shall be made in the register and the Court may at once re-hear the case or make such order in regard to the re-hearing as it thinks fit.
article.html:
8Registry of application granted, and order for re-hearings.

Order 47, Rule 8

When an application for review is granted, a note thereof shall be made in the register and the Court may at once re-hear the case or make such order in regard to the re-hearing as it thinks fit.
